modules.module_title: Prepare for visiting the consumer’s location

pcs.pc_description: prepare consumer’s index list and meter reading route as per billing cycle
update the consumer’s index list regularly with new or discontinued connections

plan meter reading route efficiently as per meter reading cycle days based on total travel time involved, resources available, number of stops/meters to service and geographic conditions of the work area
keep all records, ID-card, meter reading book, hand-held device, etc. handy prior to visiting consumer’s location

modules.module_title: Visit consumer’s premises to record gas meter reading

pcs.pc_description: greet the consumer
ensure that entry will only be up to the gas meter in the presence of consumer or with their representative if gas meter is located inside the house
display proper etiquette while interacting with the consumer
follow company’s policy and procedure in case of an industrial or commercial set up
check physical status of gas meter for unauthorized connection, broken seal, tampering, any other defects or any hazardous condition like gas leakage, corrosion, etc.
verify registered consumer with meter number and their address as per the records of gas distribution company
read correct gas consumption reading from gas meter as per the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and record the same with date in meter reading book or hand-held device or smart phone
verify meter reading if consumption appears to be abnormal and record possible reasons
listen to the consumer’s queries properly and be polite and patient while responding
inform the consumer about the do’s & don’ts and safety precautions to be taken in case of leakage of gas
reschedule the visit if consumer is not available and ensure not to post average meter reading in two consecutive sequences
submit the captured readings to the concerned department for compilation of data and bill generation
maintain the complete record of each visit and consumer’s queries with respect to issues such as regulator service, excess bill amount etc., and submit the same to reporting authority
